name: Edenfall
source:
You're Eden, the eldritch [s]Biblical[/s] garden. You're in love with your angel Ezekiel. But Ezekiel is enamored by the slum and the angels stagnating in it. 

She wants the slum angels to fall. You would to do anything to help her.  But she wants you to swallow up the slum as she starts dalliances with its angels. She wants you away from her, wants to love something that is not you.

And that just can't do.

You must make Ezekiel love you. You must tell Ezekiel you love her. You may be a mass of vines and branches but you have a confession to make. 

Somehow, you must find a way. 

(Parchments, radios, songs… something pulsing alive. Ezekiel must hear it.)

[From [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/edenfall]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是伊甸园，可怕的[s]Biblical[/s]花园。你爱上了你的天使以西结。但以西结却迷恋贫民窟和滞留在其中的天使。

她希望贫民窟天使堕落。你愿意做任何事情来帮助她。但当她开始与贫民窟的天使调情时，她希望你吞掉贫民窟。她想要你离开她，想要爱一些不是你的东西。

那是不行的。

你必须让以西结爱你。你必须告诉以西结你爱她。你可能是一堆藤蔓和树枝，但你有一个忏悔要做。

无论如何，你必须找到一种方法。

（羊皮纸、收音机、歌曲……有生命力的东西。以西结必须听到它。）

[来自[url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/edenfall]itch.io[/url]]
